feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump signs order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America
entry.summary: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

entry.title: Hundreds killed, over 1,000 missing after flash floods in Nepal and Tibet
entry.summary: Hundreds of people were killed by devastating flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away roads, bridges and entire villages. More than 1,000 people are still missing.

entry.title: 'It's essentially been one long day': A daughter details search for parents in Nepal
entry.summary: Shreya Ahuja is searching for her parents after devastating floods struck Nepal. She is calling for international help and communications access as her family waits for news.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Over 400 people were killed by the flash floods in Nepal and Tibet, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to give a speech Friday, Judge hears argument in fight to restore Trump's name to Kennedy Center.

entry.title: Mike D thought making music was behind him. Then came 'Thank You'
entry.summary: His first solo album finds the Beastie Boys rapper making music with his sons and embracing the unpredictability of collaboration.

entry.title: Six months after war's start, feelings of abandonment set in for Iranians
entry.summary: A war that was supposed to last weeks and end Iran's Islamic regime has now been underway for six months. People inside Iran who were initially hopeful have grown increasingly disillusioned.

entry.title: Palestinians ban kites after Israel says wayward kites will be treated as act of war
entry.summary: Palestinians have started burning and banning kids kites after Israel says they'll treat them as hostile acts if they blow across the border.

entry.title: Trump administration proposal would allow federal grants to be terminated on a whim
entry.summary: New Trump-led proposals to change how federal grants are decided could spell trouble for blue cities and states, The Indicator reports.

entry.title: Jury begins deliberations in Lindsay Clancy murder trial
entry.summary: The jury has begun deliberating in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Boston-area mother accused of murdering her three young children.

entry.title: Conservative group to award State Department employees who support Trump's agenda
entry.summary: A conservative group is planning cash prizes for State Department employees who fight DEI and help deport migrants.
